states.meaning: The render is not complete. The Renderer shows nothing
The frames have no rows. The Renderer shows No data, as Grafana does
The Renderer shows an error message in place of the chart

errors.when: The viz spec is not an object, or a required field is missing
errors.message: The viz spec is not correct: <field> is missing.

errors.when: specVersion is not a version that the Renderer supports
errors.message: This viz spec version (<n>) is not supported. Supported versions: <list>.

errors.when: panel.type is not a panel ID of panel-types.json
errors.message: Panel type <type> is not supported. Supported types: <list>.

errors.when: Each entry of data.results has an error
The panel shows its own error view in place of the chart
An error occurs in the Renderer after the checks of the viz spec
errors.message: This data cannot be shown as a <panelName>.

toolErrors.when: The frames have data, and they do not meet the fits condition of the type from the model
The structured content of the tool result is larger than maxResultBytes
toolErrors.message: The result is larger than <maxResultBytes> bytes. Use a shorter range, a larger intervalMs or fewer series.

refresh.when: The App calls setRefreshed(false, error) with an error text, or onRefresh throws
The App calls setRefreshed(false) with no error text

refresh.message: Refresh failed: no result in time.
